steps: Activate Put in $100; inspect the actual input value as 100.
Open View basket; verify Growth heading remains below the fixed 76px header.
Switch Redeem and In kind; inspect both real explanatory states without signing.
Open Privacy and export the original partial measurement.
Stop the real private worker; inspect rejected read and direct successes 0 → 0.
Export the after measurement, reload to reconnect, then restore Explore.
checks.observed: Actions worked without any financial transaction. Raw exports report partial-session and an empty lifecycle.

intentionalDepartures: Keep truthful existing safety/privacy/feed/simulation copy rather than generated claims of reliability or one-transaction exposure.
Use actual on-chain basket alias/provenance, values and weights; no generated numbers are used as evidence.
Preserve existing licensed fonts, icons and real controls. Replacement composition is not claimed pixel-identical.
limitations: No connected-wallet flow, CRE broadcast or full privacy lifecycle acceptance occurred.
Mobile uses a measured same-origin browser frame; physical touch and complete accessibility conformance were not tested.
The direct browser view was resized during capture; actual image dimensions are recorded and fixed frames were used for final matching views.
